topCreatives.headline: Does a strong corporate culture lead to better firm performance?
topCreatives.copy:
Does a strong corporate culture lead to better firm performance?
 
Our analysis suggests that firms with a better culture may outperform the market. We see that as the score for culture increases, the return of assets \(ROA\) for the firms on average also increases. This shows that firms with better cultures tend to be better quality firms. 

🔗 Read more on how it could potentially lead to better long-term investment outcomes: https://bit.ly/4imC3zR

{hashtag|\#|marketingcommunication}
 
\*This content is intended for institutional/professional investors or financial advisers outside of Germany only. Capital at Risk.
